
Calculates ET/P partitioning

```{r setup docs}
snow_classes <- raster("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/Snow Classifications/snowClass_resample_terraclim_resolution.tif")
snow_classes_cropped <- crop(snow_classes, 
                             raster("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/6_snow_droughts/northern/modified_boundaries/1959.tif"))

swe_files <- list.files("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/6_snow_droughts/northern/modified_boundaries/", full.names = TRUE)

```

This is calculating the yearly partitioning of P/ET to see how it is changing over time with allocation--more going to ET during this time?
```{r calculating partition}

outs_part <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = length(swe_files)*25,ncol = 6))
names(outs_part) <- c("Year", "SnowClass","SnowDrought","p","t","aet")
count = 1

for (file in swe_files) {
  
  swe <- raster(file)
  name <- strsplit(file,"/")[[1]][8]
  
  p <- raster(paste("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/4_average_yearly/northern/Precip/",name, sep=""))
  t <- raster(paste("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/4_average_yearly/northern/Temp/",name, sep=""))
  aet <- raster(paste("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/4_average_yearly/northern/AET/",name, sep=""))
  
  brick1 <- crop(brick(p,t,aet),swe)
  brick2 <- stack(brick1,swe,snow_classes_cropped)
  brick.df <- as.data.frame(brick2,xy=TRUE)
  names(brick.df) <- c("x","y","p","t","aet","SnowDrought","SnowClass")
  
  brick.df <- brick.df[which(is.na(brick.df$SnowDrought)==FALSE),] 
  brick.df <- brick.df %>% select(p,t,aet,SnowDrought,SnowClass) %>% filter(SnowClass < 7)
  
  final <- brick.df %>% 
    group_by(SnowClass,SnowDrought) %>% 
    summarize_all(mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  

  outs_part$Year[count:(count+nrow(final)-1)] <- strsplit(name,".tif")[[1]][1]
  outs_part$SnowClass[count:(count+nrow(final)-1)] <- final$SnowClass
  outs_part$SnowDrought[count:(count+nrow(final)-1)] <- final$SnowDrought
  outs_part$p[count:(count+nrow(final)-1)] <- final$p
  outs_part$t[count:(count+nrow(final)-1)] <- final$t
  outs_part$aet[count:(count+nrow(final)-1)] <- final$aet

  
  count = count + 1 + nrow(final)
  
}


outs_part2 <- outs_part[which(is.na(outs_part$SnowClass)==FALSE),]

write.csv(outs_part2,"D:/NASA/SBG Drought/yearly_averate_p_t_aet_partitioning.csv")
```

```{r plotting partitioning}
part <- read.csv("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/yearly_averate_p_t_aet_partitioning.csv")
p_partition <- part %>% dplyr::select(Year,SnowClass,SnowDrought,p,aet) %>% mutate(e = aet/p) %>% dplyr::select(Year,SnowClass,SnowDrought,e,p)
precip <- p_partition %>% dplyr::select(p,Year,SnowClass,SnowDrought)
p_partition <- p_partition %>% dplyr::select(Year,SnowClass,SnowDrought,e) #dropping precipitation

part_long <- melt(p_partition, id.vars = c("Year","SnowClass","SnowDrought"))

classes <- c("Tundra",
             "Boreal Forest",
             "Maritime",
             "Ephemeral",
             "Prairie",
             "Montane Forest") #if looking at Ice, change here , "Ice")
names(classes) <- c("1","2","3","4","5","6") #if looking at ice, change here ,"7"


part_long$SnowDrought <- factor(part_long$SnowDrought, levels = c("1","2","3","4"))
levels(part_long$SnowDrought) <- list(Dry  = "1", `No Drought` = "2", Warm = "3", `Warm & Dry` = "4")

part_long$SnowClass <- factor(part_long$SnowClass, levels = c("1","2","3","4","5","6"))
levels(part_long$SnowClass) <- list(Tundra = "1",
             `Boreal Forest`="2",
             Maritime="3",
             Ephemeral="4",
             Prairie="5",
             `Montane Forest`="6")

```

```{r testing for trends in average yearly time series}
out2 <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=24,ncol=7))
names(out2) <- c("SnowClass","Drought","Linear_P","MK_P","Linear_Sig","MK_Sig","Slope")
count = 1

for (snow in unique(p_partition$SnowClass)) {
  tmp <- p_partition %>% filter(SnowClass == snow)
  
  for (drought in unique(p_partition$SnowDrought)) {
    
    tmp2 <- tmp %>% filter(SnowDrought == drought)
    p_val1 <- funtimes::notrend_test(tmp2$e)$p.value #linear trend test
    p_val2 <- funtimes::notrend_test(tmp2$e, test = "MK")$p.value #mann kendall test
    slope <- data.frame(lm(tmp2$e~tmp2$Year)[[1]][2])[1,1]
    out2[count,1] <- snow
    out2[count,2] <- drought
    out2[count,"Linear_P"] <- p_val1
    out2[count,"MK_P"] <- p_val2
    out2[count,"Slope"] <- slope
    count = count + 1
    
  }
  
  
}

out2[,c(5:6)] <- "Not Sig"
out2[which(out2$Linear_P < 0.05),"Linear_Sig"] <- "Sig"
out2[which(out2$MK_P < 0.05),"MK_Sig"] <- "Sig"

out2$SnowClass <- as.factor(out2$SnowClass)
levels(out2$SnowClass) <- list(Tundra = "1", `Boreal Forest` = "2", Maritime = "3", `Ephemeral` ="4", Prairie = "5", `Montane Forest` = "6")

out2$Drought <- factor(out2$Drought, levels = c("1","2","3","4"))
levels(out2$Drought) <- list(Dry  = "1", `No Drought` = "2", Warm = "3", `Warm & Dry` = "4")



```

I moved the plotting down here because of Noah's comment to only plto the lines that were statistically sig to save space so I am reformatting here instead
```{r plotting lines}
out3 <- out2
names(out3)[2] <- "SnowDrought"

sig_lines <- merge(part_long,out3,by = c("SnowClass","SnowDrought"))
# sig_lines <- sig_lines %>% filter(Linear_Sig == "Yes")
sig_lines$SnowDrought <- factor(sig_lines$SnowDrought, levels = c("No Drought","Dry", "Warm", "Warm & Dry"))


precip <- precip %>% dplyr::select(Year,SnowClass,p) %>% group_by(Year,SnowClass) %>% summarise_all(mean,na.rm=TRUE)
precip_long <- melt(precip, id.vars = c("Year","SnowClass"))

names(precip_long)[4] <- "Precip"
precip_long$SnowClass <- as.factor(precip_long$SnowClass)
levels(precip_long$SnowClass) <- list(Tundra = "1", `Boreal Forest` = "2", Maritime = "3", `Ephemeral` ="4", Prairie = "5", `Montane Forest` = "6")

p_e <- merge(sig_lines,precip_long, by = c("Year","SnowClass"))

###run this once to generate the legend, remplacing legend.position = "NULL" with "bottom"
#also, update the width to 7.5 from 3.75, heigh from 2 to 4 and change the name to legend
for (eco in unique(p_e$SnowClass)) {
  ecos <- p_e %>% filter(SnowClass == eco)
  coeff <- round(max(ecos$Precip)/max(ecos$value))
  part_plot_2axis <- ggplot(data = ecos,aes(x=Year,y = value,group = SnowDrought, color = SnowDrought,linetype = Linear_Sig)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_line(data = ecos,aes(x=Year,y = Precip/coeff,color = "Precipitation"))+
    labs(linetype = "",x="",title = eco)+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("grey","brown","red","orange","black"), na.value = "NA") + #add "blue" as the first entry here if dry snow droughts used
    stat_smooth(method = "lm",se=FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("dashed","solid"))+
    scale_y_continuous(
    
    # Features of the first axis
      name = "", #ET/P
    
    # Add a second axis and specify its features
      sec.axis = sec_axis( trans=~.*coeff, name="") #Precip (mm)
    ) +
      labs(color = "") + theme_classic() +
      theme(strip.background = element_rect(color = "NA"),
            legend.position = "NULL", #change here for legend or normal figs
             plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
      guides(linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "black")))
   
   name <- substr(eco,1,5)
   # name <- "legend"
   png(paste("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/partition_precip/",name,".png",sep=""),
       width = 4, height = 2,units = "in", res=800) #for legend: width = 7 & height = 4; for others: width = 4 & height = 2
   print(part_plot_2axis)
   dev.off()
}





```

This is calculating the anoms based on the historical mean (normal anomaly calculation). Not using no snow droughts as the baseline but trying to capture how ET anomalies within each of the snow drought and snow classification types is changing
```{r making winter 6 month normal for AET}

monthly <- data.frame(list.files("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/3_snow_grid_masked_area/AET/",full.names=TRUE)) #change name of variable here
names(monthly) <- c("Files")
monthly$Year <- substr(monthly$Files,83,86)
monthly$Month <- substr(monthly$Files,88,89)

monthly2 <- monthly %>% dplyr::filter(Month == "11" | Month == "12" | Month == "01" | Month == "02" | Month == "03" | Month == "04" )

north <- calc(stack(monthly2$Files),fun=mean,na.rm=TRUE)
writeRaster(north,"D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/5_winter_normals/northern/aet.tif") #change name of variable here

```
